requirements.text: Degree in Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position, in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position
requirements.evidence: A) Degree: Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position.

requirements.text: Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown in paragraph A above, plus additional education or appropriate experience
requirements.evidence: OR B) Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown in paragraph A above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.

requirements.text: At least 52 weeks of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-11 in the federal service
requirements.evidence: In addition to the basic requirements above, applicants must have at least 52 weeks of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-11 in the federal service.

requirements.text: Experience maintaining machine learning, natural language processing, and/or artificial intelligence systems in production
requirements.evidence: Experience for this position includes at least three of the following: Maintaining machine learning, natural language processing, and/or artificial intelligence systems in production;

requirements.text: Assisting in research and evaluation of state-of-the-art topics in data science, such as deep learning and large language models
requirements.evidence: Assisting in research and evaluation of the state-of-the-art topics in data science, such as deep learning and large language models;

requirements.text: Using data engineering techniques to process large, complex datasets into structured formats for record matching, anomaly detection, data analysis, and/or estimation
requirements.evidence: Using data engineering techniques to process large, complex datasets into structured formats for record matching, anomaly detection, data analysis, and/or estimation;

requirements.text: Writing high-quality, maintainable code for analytics and applications using the Python programming language
requirements.evidence: Writing high-quality, maintainable code for analytics and applications using the Python programming language.
